question: Is RDRAND determinized under hermit, or only hidden by CPUID masking? What does a guest that executes it without consulting CPUID observe?
binary: debug build of hermit at the above SHA, ptrace backend
answer: Only hidden. Detcore's sole RDRAND handling is the CPUID mask in detcore/src/cpuid.rs; there is no instruction-level determinization. A guest that ignores CPUID reads host entropy under --strict (3 distinct values in 3 runs). --verify catches it only when the value reaches stdout; when consumed internally, --verify returns 0 and the DETLOG/INFO traces are byte-identical.
not_established: Whether masking-only is the intended product boundary or a gap -- that is an owner call.
The silent-consumer case under --verify-strict: that mode timed out on this host (known verify-hang), so plain --verify was used.
Non-ptrace backends were not measured for this surface.
